description: Three inverters in 3HP, working either on logic gates or on the signal itself

params.text: A two-position switch choosing Digital, where each section inverts a gate, or Analog, where each section flips the sign of the voltage at its input

inputs.text: In Digital the voltage here counts as true above 0V, an empty jack counting as false; in Analog it is the signal whose sign is flipped

outputs.text: In Digital, 10V while that section's input is false and 0V while it is true; in Analog, that section's input with its sign flipped

notes: Mono only: a polyphonic cable patched in is read as its first channel alone, and each output carries one channel
